production.direction_en: Two Choir Knights sing without moving their mouths. A pale ward passes from shield to shield.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_ch2_cathedral with wordless male choir (the Choir Knights) | post: bgm_warmth (Aveline, candles)

commands.speaker: sister_aveline
commands.text: I will stay until every candle in the refuge is lit. Then I will follow the records.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: You should not have to choose between people and the truth.

commands.speaker: sister_aveline
commands.text: Someone always has to choose. Let us make sure it is not the children.
